R01.music: Rasterization = quantized waveform. Ray tracing = convolution reverb.

R02.music: Energy conservation in audio mixing. Light bounces = harmonic overtones.

R03.music: Vertex = pitch transform. Fragment = timbre color. Compute = DSP batch.

R04.topic: GPU Architecture and the Render Pipeline
R04.music: GPU pipeline = parallel audio track processing. SIMD = chord voicing.

R05.music: Z-buffer = audio priority mixing. Depth test = sidechain compression.

R06.music: glTF = stem file format. Binary blobs = raw audio buffers.

R07.music: Scene graph = song arrangement. Parent-child = sends and returns.

R08.music: Global illumination = room acoustics. Bounce = early reverb reflections.

R09.music: Path tracing = Monte Carlo noise floor. Convergence = de-noising with more samples.

R10.music: Shadow map = audio masking. Penumbra = frequency overlap between sounds.

R11.music: Ambient occlusion = sub-bass in tight spaces. Crevice = low-end buildup.

R12.music: VMA = audio buffer pool. Suballocation = sample slicing and reuse.

R13.topic: Compute Shaders and Tiled Deferred Lighting
R13.music: Compute = parallel DSP. Tiled deferred = multiband compressor.

R14.music: G-buffer = stem separation. Deferred pass = mixing after all tracks recorded.

R15.music: TAA = audio smoothing across frames. Ghost artifacts = IIR filter pre-ringing.

R16.music: DLSS = AI upsampling like iZotope RX restoration.

R17.music: NeRF = reconstructing 3D audio from sparse mic captures.

R18.music: Gaussian splatting = granular synthesis. Each splat = a grain.

R19.topic: Real-Time Ray Tracing with AI Denoising
R19.music: RT denoising = noise reduction on recorded audio.

R20.topic: Rendering for Music Visualization Spectral to Visual
R20.music: FFT spectrum to color. Bass = red. Mid = green. High = blue. BPM = frame rate.
